_bio: THE person. Taken before the game begins; the reason Jake flew into the kill-box. Held longest, on Floor 7 - the one detention cell in the Executive Suite's paradise. She has watched the tower run from the inside and kept herself whole by counting everything: patrols, meal cycles, the elevator's hum. Not broken. Furious, precise, and certain Jake would come.

nodes.line: *she's standing at the field, exactly where you left her* Still here. Still counting. What's the plan, Jake?

choices.text: Working on the field. Hold on.

nodes.line: *she turns before you make a sound - she knew your footsteps* Six months. They kept saying you were dead and I kept telling them they didn't know you. *her hand flat against the containment field* Hi.

choices.text: Six months? It's been two days for me since the crash.

nodes.line: I know you are. *she almost smiles* I've had six months to learn this floor. The field on this cell isn't on the grid - it's keyed to a bio-signature. Theirs was a joke at first. Then they grew him.
Two days. *she laughs once, no humor in it* They put you under, Jake. Six months on ice while they built things out of your file. One of those things walks around this floor wearing your face.

choices.text: The clone. I've heard it moving.

nodes.line: A farm. Floor two grows soldiers out of women they take. Floor six is where the things that RUN this place live. And floor seven is where they keep the leverage. *she taps the field* I'm leverage.

choices.text: Not anymore. How do I open this?

nodes.line: They call it the Successor. Your gait, your aim, your stubbornness - they measured all of it. The field reads HIS signature as the master key. *her eyes are steady* You understand what I'm telling you to do.
The arena past the observation deck. It trains there. Jake - *the first crack in her voice* - it fights exactly like you. Don't fight fair.

*the field stutters and dies before you reach her - she steps through the doorway like she's done it in her head a thousand times* There you are. Roof. Helipad. NOW - and Jake? *she takes the pistol off the dead guard by the door* I'm not cargo.
*the field hums between you, indifferent* Still up. Still keyed to him. Go finish it - I'll be here. I'm ALWAYS here. *she says it like a joke; it isn't one*

banter.line: Six months I mapped this place in my head. Left at the dead ficus.
The girls on two - Keisha, Emily, Aria. Tell me you went back for them.
You still walk too loud. I could hear you two rooms away. It's how I knew you weren't one of them.
Helipad. Beacon. Home. Say it back to me so I know you're not improvising.
When we're out, you're telling me EVERYTHING about the ship. You crashed it, didn't you.
